draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.90, the 172nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 21st of 34 at DE. He went 90th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (172nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (8th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 3rd in sacks among the 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers. 61 career games and 9 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 edge rusher who played: 1.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
